title: A lighthouse keeper's day
checked: Every reachable state checked (10 states, 21 with their data, 25 steps). All 3 rules hold.

rules.rule: Every step can happen, and none is a dead end
rules.says: Each of the 10 states is reached from the start, every step can fire, and no state leaves you stuck.
From the evening to sunrise the lamp is never dark.
rules.path: Take away the lamp burns guard and it breaks in 15 steps: next step, sunrise, next step, next step, next step, next step, light the lamp, next step, next step, sunrise, next step, next step, next step, next step, light the lamp.

rules.says: The keeper never carries up more oil than the tank holds.
rules.path: Take away the tank not full guard and it breaks in 7 steps: next step, sunrise, next step, next step, next step, carry oil up, carry oil up.
